points.why: The answer takes the graph for granted and covers consistency and changing facts, but never argues why a graph beats a diagram.
It bases the choice on the edge model: property graphs put timeouts and retries on edges, while RDF suits merging external datasets and semantic standards. It omits Neptune and the W3C framing.
It separates reachability, answered by transitive traversal, from dynamics that need a separate simulation, and it names retry amplification and feedback loops.
It asks for provenance, last_seen timestamps and cross-checking declared against observed edges, but never says to verify dependency facts the agent extracted itself.
